# Verify all milestone requirements are met by checking public names

import subprocess

# Check that __getitem__ exists in VersionInfo
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "-n", "def __getitem__", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("__getitem__:", result.stdout.strip())

# Check comparator allows list and str
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "comparable_types", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("comparable_types:", result.stdout.strip())

# Check deprecation warnings exist for all required functions
for func in ['parse', 'format_version', 'bump_major', 'bump_minor', 'bump_patch', 
             'bump_prerelease', 'bump_build', 'finalize_version', 'replace']:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["grep", f"deprecated.*{func}", "semver.py"],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if result.stdout:
        print(f"Deprecation for {func}: OK")
    else:
        print(f"Deprecation for {func}: MISSING!")
